_comment: Which microphone and camera requests a shell's web view grants (native-shells "Microphone for voice capture"), read by Android's WebMicrophoneTest and the iOS app's MediaCaptureTests. `origin`: the top-level page; `frame`: the asking frame when it is an embedded one. `grant`: what Android grants of the request (it can grant the microphone alone). `whole`: whether iOS grants the request, which WebKit decides as a whole, so a request that also asks for the camera is refused there.

cases.name: the server's page asks for the microphone
the same origin written with its default port
the server's page asks for the camera and the microphone
the server's page asks for the camera alone
the server's host over plain http
the server's host on another port
a host that only starts with the server's
another site's frame embedded in the server's page
the server's own frame inside a sign-in provider's page
